title: Military helicopters following researchers at the crash site
place_text: Aztec crash site, Hart Canyon, New Mexico

tellings.quote: Uh Bill claimed that a couple times at the crash site as he was leaving, he was followed by helicopters, military helicopters. And that actually happened to us once when we were putting the plaque in.

plain: Scott Ramsay, a researcher of a UFO crash said to have happened near Aztec, New Mexico, says an earlier researcher of that case, Bill Steinman, claimed he was followed by military helicopters a couple of times as he left the crash site in Hart Canyon. Ramsay says the same thing happened to his own group once, when they were putting up a plaque at the site. To him it suggests the military was still watching the place decades later.
